unverified.detail: Not yet recorded; awaiting a run of the Record workflow against the live, public, credential-free API.

spec.description: List every market Bitstamp trades, spot and perpetual alike, with its trading status and order-size limits.

request.title: ListMarketsRequest
request.description: No parameters; always returns every market.

response.title: MarketList
response.description: Every market, in no documented order.

items.description: One market. `market_type` tells `SPOT` and `PERPETUAL` apart: a perpetual market carries the contract terms a spot pair has none of.

market_symbol.description: Symbol used in every other endpoint's URL, such as `btcusd`.

base_currency.description: Currency being bought or sold, such as `BTC`.

base_decimals.description: Decimal places Bitstamp accepts for an order amount in `base_currency`.

counter_currency.description: Currency prices are quoted in, such as `USD`.

counter_decimals.description: Decimal places Bitstamp accepts for an order price in `counter_currency`.

minimum_order_value.description: Smallest order value Bitstamp accepts, in `counter_currency`.

trading.description: Whether regular trading is open on this market.

instant_order_counter_decimals.description: Decimal places Bitstamp accepts for an instant/market order's value in `counter_currency`.

instant_and_market_orders.description: Whether instant and market orders are open on this market.

description.description: Human-readable market description, such as `Bitcoin / U.S. dollar`.

market_symbol.description: Symbol used in every other endpoint's URL, such as `btcusd-perp`.

base_currency.description: Asset the contract tracks, such as `BTC`.

base_decimals.description: Decimal places Bitstamp accepts for a contract amount in `base_currency`.

counter_currency.description: Currency the contract is margined and quoted in, such as `USD`.

counter_decimals.description: Decimal places Bitstamp accepts for a price in `counter_currency`.

minimum_order_value.description: Smallest order value Bitstamp accepts, in `counter_currency`.

maximum_order_value.description: Largest order value Bitstamp accepts, in `counter_currency`.

minimum_order_amount.description: Smallest order amount Bitstamp accepts, in `base_currency`.

maximum_order_amount.description: Largest order amount Bitstamp accepts, in `base_currency`.

trading.description: Whether regular trading is open on this contract.

instant_order_counter_decimals.description: Decimal places Bitstamp accepts for an instant/market order's value in `counter_currency`.

instant_and_market_orders.description: Whether instant and market orders are open on this contract.

description.description: Human-readable contract description, such as `Bitcoin / U.S. dollar Perpetual`.

underlying_asset.description: Reference price index the contract is marked against, such as `Kaiko BTC Benchmark Reference Rate`.

payoff_type.description: How the contract's payoff is denominated. Every contract observed today is `Linear`; left a plain string since Bitstamp does not publish this as a closed set.

max_leverage.description: Maximum leverage Bitstamp allows on this contract.

isin.description: International Securities Identification Number assigned to the contract.

asset_class.description: Asset class the underlying belongs to.

has_market_hours.description: Whether the contract only trades during set market hours, rather than continuously.

notes: `asset_class` is enumerated from every value the 20 live perpetual markets carry today (`CRYPTO`, `FX`, `COMMODITIES`, `ETF`) rather than from prose Bitstamp publishes as a closed set; a new asset class would be a fifth value this enum does not yet know.
The older `GET /api/v2/trading-pairs-info/` this replaces returned `minimum_order` as a currency-suffixed string (`"10.00000 USD"`) rather than a bare decimal; that endpoint is not specced here.
